import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INF = 2000000000;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 210;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = 2 * MAX_SIZE * MAX_SIZE;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int SOURCE = MAX_SIZE - 2;
    static final int SINK = MAX_SIZE - 1;

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int[] to = new int[MAX_EDGES];
        int[] flow = new int[MAX_EDGES];
        int[] capacity = new int[MAX_EDGES];
        int edgeCount = 0;

        List<Integer>[] adj = new List[MAX_SIZE];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAX_SIZE];

        FlowNetwork() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
            to[edgeCount] = v;
            flow[edgeCount] = 0;
            capacity[edgeCount] = cap;
            adj[u].add(edgeCount++);
            
            to[edgeCount] = u;
            flow[edgeCount] = 0;
            capacity[edgeCount] = 0;
            adj[v].add(edgeCount++);
        }

        boolean augment(int node, int target, int amount) {
            if (node == target) {
                return true;
            }

            visited[node] = true;

            for (int idx : adj[node]) {
                if (!visited[to[idx]] && capacity[idx] - flow[idx] >= amount &&
                    augment(to[idx], target, amount)) {
                    
                    flow[idx] += amount;
                    flow[idx ^ 1] -= amount;

                    return true;
                }
            }
            
            return false;
        }

        int computeMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            int amount = 1 << 30;
            int total = 0;

            while (amount > 0) {
                if (augment(source, sink, amount)) {
                    total += amount;
                } else {
                    amount >>= 1;
                }

                Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            }

            return total;
        }
    }

    static FlowNetwork network = new FlowNetwork();
    static int gridSize, maxSteps;
    static char[][] initial = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] target = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] seen = new boolean[15][15];

    static boolean inBounds(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < gridSize &&
               0 <= y && y < gridSize &&
               initial[x][y] != 'Y' &&
               initial[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void computeDistances(int startX, int startY) {
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[startX][startY] = 0;
        qx.add(startX);
        qy.add(startY);

        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            assert !qy.isEmpty();

            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[k];
                int ny = cy + dy[k];

                if (inBounds(nx, ny) && dist[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[cx][cy] + 1;
                    qx.add(nx);
                    qy.add(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void explore(int startX, int startY) {
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qlevel = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(seen[startX], false);
        
        seen[startX][startY] = true;
        qx.add(startX);
        qy.add(startY);
        qlevel.add(0);

        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            assert !qy.isEmpty();

            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();
            int level = qlevel.poll();

            if (Character.isDigit(target[cx][cy]) && target[cx][cy] != '0') {
                network.connect(startX * gridSize + startY, gridSize * gridSize + 1 + cx * gridSize + cy, INF);
            }
            
            if (level >= maxSteps) {
                continue;
            }

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[k];
                int ny = cy + dy[k];

                if (inBounds(nx, ny) && !seen[nx][ny]) {
                    if (dist[nx][ny] > level + 1) {
                        qx.add(nx);
                        qy.add(ny);
                        qlevel.add(level + 1);
                    } else if (dist[nx][ny] > level && Character.isDigit(target[nx][ny]) && target[nx][ny] != '0') {
                        network.connect(startX * gridSize + startY, gridSize * gridSize + 1 + nx * gridSize + ny, INF);
                    }

                    seen[nx][ny] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void constructGraph() {
        int startX = -1, startY = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize && startX == -1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize && startX == -1; j++) {
                if (initial[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                }
            }
        }

        computeDistances(startX, startY);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(initial[i][j]) && initial[i][j] != '0') {
                    network.connect(SOURCE, i * gridSize + j, initial[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(target[i][j]) && target[i][j] != '0') {
                    network.connect(i * gridSize + j + gridSize * gridSize + 1, SINK, target[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(initial[i][j]) && initial[i][j] != '0') {
                    explore(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        gridSize = sc.nextInt();
        maxSteps = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            initial[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }

        sc.nextLine(); // consume empty line

        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            target[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }

        constructGraph();

        System.out.println(network.computeMaxFlow(SOURCE, SINK));
    }
}
